title: Compute the characteristic number of a conic-line arrangement

source.citation: Bounds for characteristic numbers of conic-line arrangements in the plane, arXiv:2312.12950

translation.notes: The paper records 21 lines, 21 conics, and 42, 252, and 189 points of multiplicities two, three, and four. Exact rational substitution refines its decimal `2.512` to `108/43`.
